overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: even after an executive session purpose expires, a body may still withhold or redact minutes under attorney-client privilege.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board wrongly refused to publicly release March 2009 executive session minutes after their purposes had expired.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law because, even where the executive session purpose has expired, a public body may still redact or withhold executive session minutes on the basis of attorney-client privilege.
